newsitem.title: CANADA: Onex acquires two OEM suppliers.
newsitem.headline: Onex acquires two OEM suppliers.

text.p: Onex Corp said on Friday its Dura Automotive Systems Inc unit is acquiring two originial equipment manufacturer (OEM) suppliers, KPI Automotive Group for C$110 million and the parking brake business of Rockwell Light Vehicle Systems for C$5 million.
Onex said Dura agreed to purchase U.S.-based KPI from Sparton Corp for about C$110 million, financed by Dura through its credit facilities.
Dura purchased the France-based parking brake business of Rockwell for about C$5 million, which was paid with cash on hand at Dura, Onex said.

KPI, which has annual revenues of about C$130 million, manufactures products that include automotive shifter systems, parking brake machanisms, brake pedals, underbody spare tire carriers and air-bag components for Ford Motor Co, Chrysler Corp, General Motors Co and other tier- one suppliers to the automotive industry.
Rockwell's parking brake business has annual revenues of about C$11 million and its principal customers are PSA and Renault SA, Onex said.
